statement: Fresh Tr MP+Nunchuk with external-style inactive ID creation option passes native Dolphin 2503 bounded decoded gyro and Nunchuk stick. Consumer pre-map A600FE mode byte is 00 before first activation, with no earlier consumer or host output. Mode 05, report-mode resend, F6 and exact imported MP/child calibration succeed; independent dense samples show opposite decoded stick positions and changing gyro. No post-map native A400F0=55 or A600F0=55. No inherited Original or retained-mode-05 acceptance; no physical/radio/game/release/timing or whole-controller qualification.

applicability.revision: Tr / virtual Wii Remote Plus PID 0330; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9i two independent fresh virtual Tr candidates, generic test/dev binding under #258, imported synthetic calibration, re-attach/F6/copy on. FE byte 00 is native readback; full inactive identity is not read back. No physical/radio/game/release/timing or whole-controller qualification.
